messages:
Sam (Sales): NordicBank wants an EU-only POC. Requirements: inference + embeddings, backups/snapshots, and monitoring must never leave EU. They want the full subprocessor list, a written attestation, and an operations runbook showing failover stays in EU. Can presales/ops/security/legal confirm feasibility and timelines?

Akash (Presales): Brief answer: feasible. Options: Hosted with tenant pinning + EU control plane opt-in, Dedicated reserved capacity, or Private (on-prem/VPC). Important: embedding cache snapshots and async backup jobs default to provider-managed object storage in the region but replication rules may replicate cross-region for DR; we must disable that for the POC.

Ellie (Ops): Current subprocessors doc: https://internal.redwood/ops/subprocessors.csv (will attach copy). For EU POCs we normally run in eu-west-1 and eu-central-1. Snapshot flow: snapshot -> eu-west-1 object store; periodic cross-region replication to us-east happens only for long-term DR buckets. For POC we can flip replication off. Need confirmation if customer wants active-active inside EU or single-primary with EU-only failover.

Maya (Security): Default telemetry/alerts pipeline ships to US endpoints. For an EU-only POC we can enable telemetry_mode: eu-only and point to EU Datadog/Sentry partitions. I'll prepare a residency attestation template and include SOC2/ISO links. Also need the customer's data-protection contact for attestation signature.

Priya (Legal): We can provide subprocessor list + DPA excerpt. If they require contract language guaranteeing control-plane locality we need Legal Ops review; that may add ~3 business days. Please collect exact clause they want.

Sam (Sales): NordicBank prefers active-active across two EU regions (they mentioned eu-west-1 and eu-north-1). They also explicitly asked: "Are any ephemeral keys or indexing jobs sent to non-EU ML services during async index build?"

Akash (Presales): Ephemeral indexing jobs run on our runtime in the region; they do not call US-managed inference endpoints. However some auxiliary analytics jobs (usage aggregates) run in control-plane services that by default are multi-region. For POC we can set control_plane_mode: dedicated-eu to keep those in EU. Example POC config we can propose to customer:

```
deployment:
  mode: hosted-pinned
  active_regions:
    - eu-west-1
    - eu-north-1
  replication_policy: within-eu-only
  snapshot:
    cross_region_replication: disabled
  control_plane:
    mode: dedicated-eu
    provision_eta: 10 business days
  telemetry_mode: eu-only
  embedding_cache_policy: store-in-region-only
  kms: byo (azure-key-vault-eu-north)
  failover_policy:
    type: region-failover
    allowed_regions: [eu-west-1, eu-north-1, eu-central-1]
    exclude_global: true
```

Note: eu-north-1 is supported for BYO-KMS (Azure Key Vault) but not all internal analytics endpoints are deployed there; we may route analytics to eu-west-1 within EU.

ops-bot: Ticket created PR-4999: eu-controlplane-eu-only-poc. Owner: Ellie. ETA: ~10 business days to provision dedicated EU control plane.

Ellie (Ops): Ops checklist for NordicBank POC:
- Provide subprocessors CSV (attached once PR-4999 accepted)
- Disable cross-region replication for POC buckets
- Configure Datadog/Sentry -> EU partitions (need customer org IDs)
- Accept customer BYO-KMS config (need tenant id + key vault URL + role binding)
- Provision dedicated EU control plane (10 business days)
Estimated POC cost uplift: ~+25% (control plane + BYO-KMS ops + EU partitioning).

Maya (Security): I'll DM Sam the residency attestation draft and links to SOC2/ISO. Also: if NordicBank requires an independent scan or a dataflow diagram with network egress assertions, please ask and we'll produce a redacted diagram for the POC.

Priya (Legal): Requested items from customer: DP contact, required contractual clause text (if any), and whether they need a data-processor addendum amendment. Once provided I can aim to sign off in 3 business days.

Sam (Sales): NordicBank can provide DP contact and needs the attestation + subprocessor CSV by EOD tomorrow. They also want a short runbook showing steps during region failure and a test plan proving no egress.

Akash (Presales): Proposed test plan (summary):
1) Deploy POC with routing config above
2) Run synthetic inference + embedding jobs and capture network flows
3) Verify snapshot writes remain in EU and replication is off
4) Trigger planned failover to second EU region and verify no traffic leaves EU
5) Deliver signed network flow logs + runbook to customer
We'll attach the scripts for their auditors.

Ellie (Ops): Please collect BYO-KMS details and Datadog org id. I'll attach subprocessors CSV here and the short runbook once PR-4999 is in progress.

Sam (Sales): I'll gather the DP contact, Datadog org id, and Key Vault URL today. Thanks all 64f

Priya (Legal): Marking this as high priority. I'll review attestation language once Maya posts it.

Maya (Security): Posted attestation draft to Sam's DM; will paste a non-sensitive excerpt here when Sam confirms we can publish to thread.

Sam (Sales): Confirmed 0: please paste excerpt here and I'll forward to customer. Leaving thread open for updates. :pray:
